# MDD Sim Gateway v1.7.0

## 中文

v1.7.0 新增飞书/Lark 通知通道和测试版本管理，同时合入 v1.6.1 候选版本期间完成的网络出口修复。

### 飞书/Lark 通知

- 新增飞书/Lark 自定义机器人，与 Webhook、Telegram、PushPlus 共用现有通知事件、开关、消息模板、测试推送、失败重试和投递记录。
- 支持飞书与 Lark 官方机器人地址，以及可选的 HMAC-SHA256 签名校验。
- 不再把任意 HTTP 200 当作成功；平台返回业务错误时会明确判定失败并重试。
- 支持包会脱敏机器人 Webhook Token 和签名密钥。
- Telegram 可选择直连、代理库条目或已有国家出口；旧版手动代理设置仍可继续使用。
- 各通知通道的“转发以下事件”改为折叠区域，与自定义通知文案保持一致。

### 更新与网络出口

- 系统设置现在可以列出并安装已发布的候选测试版本，也可以从测试版本切回正常发布版本；草稿版本不会显示，自动更新仍遵循稳定版推广策略。
- 更新联网方式可选自动、直连、代理库条目或指定国家出口；旧版手动代理会迁入代理库，旧版国家出口选择保持不变。
- 修复 [Issue #27](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/27)：VLESS Encryption 参数会正确传递给 Xray，此类节点不再因固定发送 `none` 而全部超时。
- UDP 出口验证现在交叉使用 STUN 与 DNS 探测，任一目标成功即可通过；Xray 不可用时只影响由它承载的出口。
- VLESS 的 Xray 路径统一请求 XUDP；节点测试失败原因直接显示在页面中，解析摘要中的 SNI 默认隐藏。

本版本需要同时更新 Control 与 Engine。

---

## English

v1.7.0 adds native Feishu/Lark notifications and test-Release management, and includes the network-egress fixes validated during the v1.6.1 release candidates.

### Feishu/Lark notifications

- Add Feishu/Lark custom bots alongside Webhook, Telegram and PushPlus, reusing the existing notification events, per-event switches, message templates, test delivery, retries and delivery history.
- Accept official Feishu and Lark bot endpoints with optional HMAC-SHA256 signing.
- Validate the platform response instead of treating every HTTP 200 as delivered; application-level rejection is reported and retried.
- Redact bot webhook tokens and signing secrets from support bundles.
- Let Telegram use direct networking, a proxy-library entry or an existing country exit; legacy manual-proxy settings remain usable.
- Collapse each channel's forwarded-event switches like the custom message editor.

### Updates and network egress

- System Settings can now list and install published test Releases or move a test installation back to a normal Release. Drafts stay hidden and automatic updates continue to follow the stable promotion policy.
- Let update checks and downloads use automatic fallback, direct networking, a proxy-library entry or a selected country exit while preserving legacy selections.
- Fix [Issue #27](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/27): VLESS Encryption now reaches Xray instead of being replaced with `none`, which previously made every request time out.
- Validate UDP exits with interleaved STUN and DNS probes, passing when any target answers; an unavailable Xray now fails only the exits it carries.
- Request XUDP on the VLESS Xray path, show node-test failures directly on the page, and keep SNI masked in the parsed summary by default.

Both Control and Engine are updated in this release.
